seo.title: Tangier Kasbah Museum | Hilltop Views & Palace Rooms | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Visit the Kasbah Museum in Tangier: historic rooms, gardens and panoramic views over the medina and the Strait of Gibraltar.
seo.keywords: Tangier kasbah, Kasbah Museum Tangier, Tangier viewpoint

name: Kasbah Museum
hero_subtitle: Palace-museum and strait views above the medina.

overview.title: The hill that watches the strait
overview.p1: The Kasbah Museum occupies a former sultan’s palace at the top of Tangier’s medina. Rooms display crafts and history; the terraces and gardens open toward the Strait of Gibraltar and the roofs below.
overview.p2: Combine it with a medina walk rather than as a standalone rush. Mornings are quieter; late light is better for outdoor views.

gallery.title: Kasbah views
gallery.subtitle: Museum courtyards and the strait beyond.

1.title: Quiet rooms
1.desc: Calmer museum visit before tour groups peak.

2.title: Bright terraces
2.desc: Strong light on the strait — bring sun protection.

3.title: Soft panorama
3.desc: Best outdoor light over the bay and roofs.

food.title: Eat near the kasbah
food.p1: Limited options inside the museum area — plan a café in the upper medina or return downhill.
food.li2: Petit Socco for a longer pause.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Walk up through the medina or take a petit taxi to the kasbah gate.

2.title: Tickets
2.desc: Museum entry is paid; check current hours before you climb.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: Pair with Café Hafa (nearby cliffs) or a full medina loop.

q1.question: Is the kasbah free?
q1.answer: Outdoor approaches are walkable; the museum itself has a paid ticket.

q2.question: How long is the visit?
q2.answer: About one to one and a half hours including terraces.

q3.question: Are the views worth it?
q3.answer: Yes — one of the best elevated looks at the strait and medina together.

q4.question: Hard climb?
q4.answer: Moderate slopes and steps; a taxi can drop you near the gate.

q5.question: Best time of day?
q5.answer: Late afternoon for outdoor light; morning for quieter galleries.
